newsitem.title: UK: BT "baffled" at Oftel's ban on BSkyB promo.
newsitem.headline: BT "baffled" at Oftel's ban on BSkyB promo.

text.p: British Telecommunications Plc is "baffled" by industry watchdog Oftel's decision to issue a provisional order against its promotion with satellite television broadcaster BSkyB, a spokesman said.
"We are baffled. The regulator has actually moved to block customer savings...yesterday was a bad day for customers," the spokesman told Reuters.

Oftel said the promotion, which offered customers who signed up for BT's "Friends and Family" scheme discounts on linking up to BSkyB's satellite broadcasting, was in breach of BT's licence which states it must not prefer or discriminate against anyone.
"It was open to all our customers, they can all become Friends and Family members," the BT spokesman said.
He added that the offer could save a customer around 90 stg a year in discounts on BSkyB subscriptions and credits to telephone bills.
BT is now complying with Oftel's decision, the spokesman added, but has not ruled out requesting a judicial review.
"We are ruling nothing in and ruling nothing out," he said.
